source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Osasuna Kosner Consumer appliances – air conditioning
source.note: Shirt-sponsor table row. The club's 11-Nov-2025 announcement (osasuna.es/kosner-patrocinador-osasuna-2028) confirms Kosner as main sponsor on the front through 2027-28: 'seguirá ocupando la parte frontal de la camiseta del primer equipo rojillo durante las temporadas 2026-27 y 2027-28'.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Osasuna Grupo Saltoki: Celer Lighting (home) Saltoki Home (away & third) Lighting Building and interior design
source.note: Sleeve-sponsor table row: Celer Lighting on the home kit. The white sleeve lettering on the club's official 2026-27 home-kit press photo (linked from osasuna.es/osasuna-macron-primera-equipacion-2026-2027) is consistent with the Celer Lighting lockup.

source.name: CA Osasuna: 'Osasuna y Ktech establecen una nueva alianza para las próximas tres temporadas'
source.quote: A partir de la próxima temporada, el logotipo de Kuwait Technical College (ktech) aparecerá en la espalda de las camisetas oficiales de partido de Osasuna
source.note: Back of shirt from 2026-27, deal to 30 June 2029. Confirmed by the club's 12-Aug-2026 article (osasuna.es/club-atletico-osasuna-y-kuwait-technical-college-oficializan-la-ampliacion-de-su-alianza): 'Osasuna luzca la imagen de ktech en la parte trasera de sus camisetas oficiales de partido'.

source.name: Score and Change, Overview of the 2026/2027 La Liga sponsors
source.quote: Macron continued with Levante and Osasuna, while adding a new Basque club Alavés (previously Puma).
source.note: Kit maker, recorded as partner per existing convention (same article's kit-sponsor table row 'Osasuna Macron'). The club's 3-Jul-2026 kit-launch article (osasuna.es/osasuna-macron-primera-equipacion-2026-2027) presents the Macron 2026/27 home kit.

summary: Kosner on the front (renewed to 2028), Celer Lighting on the sleeve, ktech (Kuwait Technical College) on the back from 2026-27, Macron as kit maker. Not marked complete: no cited source lists every placement (the match shorts aren't covered).
